newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus police mount inquiry over missing watches.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus police mount inquiry over missing watches.

text.p: Police in Cyprus said on Thursday they were working with Interpol to find the thieves of a shipment of rare Swatch watches.

Police said the watches valued at around 90,000 pounds ($178,000) were found missing when a container was opened in the presence of customs agents in Nicosia this week. The container arrived at the port of Limassol on March 13 from Venice.
"The seals on the container were untouched," a police spokesman said. Police suspect the theft occured outside Cyprus.
The Cyprus agent of Swatch watches, Michalis Michaelides, was quoted as telling the Cyprus Mail daily the watches were limited editions used in a worldwide tour.
